description: This file implements an alternator control system for a vehicle engine ECU, including PID regulation, PWM control, and thread management for the alternator.

classes.name: Pid
classes.description: PID controller class instance used for alternator regulation.

classes.name: Logging
classes.description: Logger class used for message output.

classes.name: PwmConfig
classes.description: Configuration for PWM signal used for alternator control.

methods.name: AltCtrlThread
methods.description: Main thread function controlling alternator behavior based on sensor inputs and configuration.

methods.name: setAltPFactor
methods.description: Sets the proportional factor for the alternator PID controller and resets it.

methods.name: applyAlternatorPinState
methods.description: Applies a given PWM state to the alternator control pin.

methods.name: setDefaultAlternatorParameters
methods.description: Initializes default parameters for the alternator control system.

methods.name: onConfigurationChangeAlternatorCallback
methods.description: Callback invoked when alternator configuration changes, to decide if PID should be reset.

methods.name: initAlternatorCtrl
methods.description: Initializes the alternator control system, setting up threads and pins.
